seriesPage.subtitle: Prestige ranking and P4P weights · {year}
seriesPage.prestigeLead: Featured championships ranked by how hard they are relative to each other. Hardness feeds directly into pound-for-pound (P4P) scores.

colHelp.rank: Series position in the prestige ranking. Higher Hardness means a higher Rank.
colHelp.series: Featured championship included in prestige and P4P calculations.
colHelp.hardness: Reflects the average difference in places drivers take compared with other series; based on event-by-event places, not season standings.
colHelp.samples: Drivers who competed in multiple series; hardness is calculated from their results.

overlap.title: 1. Pilot overlap
overlap.body: For drivers in 2+ featured series, we use mean indexPoints per event. For series X: P = S_X − S_Y, raw = −mean(P). Coefficient H = (raw + 32) / 32 — higher H means a tougher series.

p4p.title: 2. Pound-for-pound (P4P)
p4p.body: Each pilot's best score across featured series with overlap data:
p4p.note: P = mean event place, Q = mean qual score (0–100), Q contributes as Q/100. N = pilots in P4P. Lower P4P means a better result.

indexPoints.title: 3. Event indexPoints
indexPoints.body: Each event result is scored with a grid-strength factor k (Top32 reference).
indexPoints.note: k = 1 − 1/n + 1/32, where n is scoring drivers in the top-32 qual grid.

noData.title: 4. Series without overlap
noData.body: Featured series with no overlap pairs get no H coefficient and are excluded from P4P. They are listed at the bottom without a weight.
